card_image_alt: CleanLanguage.ai: Precise, direct, natural AI writing. A skill you install once, anywhere.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Free rules that strip robotic tone, filler, and jargon from AI writing on Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot, while telling your AI to keep your facts.

pages.title: The standard
pages.description: The Clean Language standard: precedence order, operating modes, core style, and what it removes and preserves.

pages.title: Examples
pages.description: Before-and-after examples showing how Clean Language rewrites generic prose while preserving every fact. These are the examples the skill uses.

pages.title: Patterns
pages.description: Spot and remove the AI writing patterns that sound generic: dash overuse, contrast framing, filler, fake enthusiasm, and corporate jargon.

pages.title: Install
pages.description: Download Clean Language, then open the setup page for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or other AI systems. No command line, coding, or GitHub experience needed.

pages.title: Install in Claude
pages.description: Click-by-click setup for Clean Language in Claude: upload the skill on the Claude website or Claude Desktop, or use a Claude Project instead.

pages.title: Install in ChatGPT
pages.description: Click-by-click setup for Clean Language in ChatGPT: upload the skill once, or build it from the instructions file if your account cannot upload one.

pages.title: Install in Gemini
pages.description: Click-by-click setup for Clean Language in Gemini: create a custom Gem on the Gemini website, then use it on the website or in the mobile app.

pages.title: Install in Copilot
pages.description: Click-by-click setup for Clean Language in Copilot: load the full skill in Copilot Studio, or paste the instructions into a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent.

pages.title: Install in other AI systems
pages.description: Set up Clean Language in local models, API-based assistants, and other AI systems that accept custom instructions, system prompts, or uploaded files.

pages.title: Verify
pages.description: Optional steps to confirm that the Clean Language download matches its published SHA-256 checksum. If you trust the source, you can skip this.

pages.title: Instructions
pages.description: The complete Clean Language instructions as plain text, ready to copy into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or any other AI.

pages.title: By channel
pages.description: How Clean Language adapts to each channel: executive, technical, governance, incident, email, chat, and report writing.

pages.title: AI writing quality assurance
pages.description: The quality checklist Clean Language uses to review finished prose: accuracy, directness, ownership, natural language, density, tone, and mechanics.

pages.title: Try it
pages.description: Try Clean Language on your own writing: copy one prompt into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot and compare the before and after.

pages.title: Disclosure
